attributes.name: Chief Sull
attributes.powers:
The difficulty of the check to acquire Chief Sull is equal to the highest difficulty to acquire a random item from the box. If you acquire Chief Sull, you may immediately banish him to put that item in your hand.

Banish this card to shuffle your location deck, examine all of its cards except the bottom one, then shuffle the deck.
